question: According to India State of Forest Report 2019, what is the total forest cover in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21.67%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total forest cover in India **0.2167.**
 
• The nation is covered in forests covering **7,13,789 square kilometers.**
 
• This represents the total forest cover in India as per the** India State of Forest Report 2019.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** India State of Forest Report** is a **biennial publication** by the **Forest Survey of India (FSI)** that provides information on the forest cover of India.
 
• The forest cover includes all lands more than **1 hectare in area**, with a tree canopy density of** more than 10%. **
 
• The report also provides information on other aspects of the forest cover, such as the type of **forests, their distribution, and changes over time**.
 
• The **2019 report** indicated an increase of **5,188 sq km** in the forest cover of India as compared to the previous report of **2017.**
